title: The Potential danger in the plan
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：potential　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 potential 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the clerk wrote of ① a potential danger in the plan in the file, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② so potential that nobody in the office would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the clerk, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the potential ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the potential danger in the plan that anybody there had ever seen, or so the file for May 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too potential to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the applicant who had come to help; the potential ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a potential buyer for the house, and said that no applicant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as potential as the buyer for the house they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was potential or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the file. What the line asked for was ⑦ something potential, and nothing besides. The applicant from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite potential; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the file kept the names of the potential ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, without complaint, she wrote of another potential danger in the plan in the same file, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less potential than anybody had expected. ⑩ The potential buyer for the house that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the potential ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 潜在（前置定语 a potential danger in the plan：1952 年书记员在卷宗里记下的那件潜在的风险）
B. adj. 潜在／可能（两处加强说法：so potential that … 与 no less potential than …）
C. adj. 潜在／可能（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 潜在（表语 too potential to do：母亲觉得它太潜在，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 可能（前置定语 a potential buyer for the house：叔叔把整件事称作一桩可能的买主）
F. adj. 可能（同级比较 as potential as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩房子可能的买主相比）
G. adj. 可能（后置定语 something potential：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 可能（受程度副词修饰 quite potential：那位申请人的评价）

items.q: a potential danger in the plan
the potential danger in the plan that
a potential buyer for the house
The potential buyer for the house that

answers.why: potential 意为“潜在”，1952 年书记员在卷宗里记下的是“一件潜在的风险”，此处作前置定语 a potential danger in the plan。
potential 意为“潜在”，此处用 so potential that 结构，说它潜在到办事处里没人敢靠近。
potential 意为“潜在”，卷宗上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的潜在方案中潜在的风险，等于最高级的说法。
potential 意为“潜在”，母亲认为这件东西“太潜在了，谁也用不上”，too potential to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
potential 意为“可能”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩可能的买主”，此处作前置定语 a potential buyer for the house。
potential 意为“可能”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩房子可能的买主一样可能”，同级比较用 as potential as。
potential 意为“可能”，卷宗上那半行字要的是“可能的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something potential。
potential 意为“可能”，邻办事处来的那位申请人认为这套计划“相当可能”，quite 修饰原级 potential。
potential 意为“可能”，no less potential than 表示“其可能不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之可能不亚于任何人的预料。
potential 意为“可能”，母亲 1964 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的可能买主”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，书记员在卷宗里记下了一件潜在的风险。（a potential danger in the plan）
它潜在到办事处里没有一个人敢靠近。（so potential that …）
母亲觉得它太潜在，谁也用不上。（too potential to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩可能的买主。（a potential buyer for the house）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩房子可能的买主一样可能。（as potential as …）
到了 1959 年，卷宗上只剩半行字：要的是一件可能的东西。（something potential）
answers: In 1952 the clerk wrote of a potential danger in the plan in the file.
It was so potential that nobody in the office would go near it.
My mother thought it too potential to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a potential buyer for the house.
He said nobody would call it as potential as the buyer for the house they had once had.
By 1959 the file asked for nothing but something potential.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 potential 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the clerk wrote of a potential danger in the plan in the file, and nobody forgot it.
It was the potential danger in the plan that anybody there had ever seen, or so the file says.
My mother thought it too potential to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a potential buyer for the house, and nobody argued with him.
The applicant from the next office called the plan quite potential, and everybody laughed.
The potential ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
